Role: Robot Learning Engineer
Company: Humanoid
Location: London, UK (King’s Cross) – on-site, five days a week
Job Type: Full-time

About Humanoid

Humanoid is building the world’s most capable, commercially scalable and safe humanoid robots. Its platform, HMND-01, is already deployed in real industrial environments, which makes Humanoid the most serious humanoid robotics company in Europe.

  • 300+ people, 34+ nationalities, flat structure: your decisions ship directly into real robots.

  • Offices in London (HQ, King’s Cross), Boston, Vancouver and San Diego.

  • Backed by serious funding, growing fast and deliberately.

  • Values: Speed, Ambition, Passion, Trust.

About the role

The Manipulation team sits at the center of everything Humanoid does. In their own words, they are the bottleneck: the work is intense, the impact is immediate, and from day one you get access to prototype hardware worth hundreds of thousands of pounds. The team works on whole-body locomotion and manipulation, using imitation learning and RL on real robots.

This is a senior or staff individual contributor role with no management track, and the team is hiring for several openings. It is not a research role: the goal is policies that work on the robot, and results are shared as blog posts, not papers.
